Integration Code
<!-- HTML: add inside any page --> <div id="hz-toggle" class="hz-toggle" onclick="hzToggle()"> <div class="hz-stars"></div> <div class="hz-skyline"></div> <div class="hz-windows"></div> <div class="hz-orb"></div> </div> <!-- JS: before </body> --> <script> function hzToggle() { var el = document.getElementById('hz-toggle'); var body = document.body; el.classList.toggle('night'); body.classList.toggle('lm'); localStorage.setItem('theme', body.classList.contains('lm') ? 'light' : 'dark'); } function hzInit() { var t = localStorage.getItem('theme'); var el = document.getElementById('hz-toggle'); if (t === 'light') { document.body.classList.add('lm'); if (el) el.classList.remove('night'); } else { document.body.classList.remove('lm'); if (el) el.classList.add('night'); } } hzInit(); </script>
